ind-continuous-vetting-enrollment-fy26q3.name: Continuous vetting enrollment, share of covered population (Trusted Workforce 2.0)
ind-continuous-vetting-enrollment-fy26q3.note: Percentages read from the PAC quarterly progress report charts; the 'all' series ran 72% in FY25 Q4, 74% in FY26 Q1 and Q2, then 78% in FY26 Q3, and the chart's y-axis spans 4,400,000–5,000,000 with no exact headcount printed [297](#cite:297). The report lists milestones of industry RapBack enrollment beginning March 2026, CV offered for the low-risk population September 2027 and full enrollment September 2028, and rates Goal #3 'Poor' [297](#cite:297). GAO reports that CV alerts requiring review rose from about 30,000 per quarter in FY2023 to over 100,000 in FY2025 Q3 [298](#cite:298). No DCSA page with an enrollment headcount was located; the figure is the PAC's, not DCSA's [297](#cite:297).

ind-clearance-timeliness-gao-ts-initial-.name: Initial Top Secret clearance timeliness, fastest 90% (GAO figure)
ind-clearance-timeliness-gao-ts-initial-.note: This is GAO's figure as printed in GAO-26-108838, separate from any DCSA-published timeliness series in the pack; GAO states that agencies 'have not met timeliness goals for nearly all phases of the security clearance process' [298](#cite:298). The 206-day average is 92 days over the 114-day goal [298](#cite:298). GAO also reports that DoD projects about \$2.2 billion more NBIS development spending through FY2031 after \$2.4 billion spent through FY2024, with major development complete by the end of FY2027 against an original 2019 target [298](#cite:298).

ind-cleared-facilities-fy2025.name: Cleared contractor facilities under the NISP
ind-cleared-facilities-fy2025.value: more than 12,500 cleared facilities; over 4,600 security reviews; over 470 industrial security personnel
ind-cleared-facilities-fy2025.note: GAO reports DCSA oversight of more than 12,500 cleared facilities and 5,500 classified IT systems in industry, with over 4,600 security reviews, over 800 documented security violations and over 1,000 open vulnerabilities in FY2025 [300](#cite:300). DCSA's industrial-security mission ran on over 470 personnel and over \$160 million that year, and contractor personnel logged 338,136 NISP-related training completions, a completion count and not a headcount [300](#cite:300). DCSA's own undated page puts the figure at about 10,000 cleared companies and 12,500 cleared facilities [300](#cite:300).
